title: Kama Floor Workshop @Moonrise
description: Discover a new way to relate to your partner with Kama Floor. A fusion of acro yoga, Thai massage, and partner dance.
long_description:
Discover a new way to relate to your partner with Kama Floor. A fusion of acro yoga, Thai massage, and partner dance.

About this Event

- Kama Floor is launching in New York. If you've tried Kama Flight in Brooklyn, now try the more grounded version of our partner wellness modality.
- This is your chance to visit the beautiful members-only moonrise space and reset your nervous system through stretch and play with your partner (moonrisespace.com)
- Spots are limited to 8 reservations per workshop - hurry to secure your spot

Agenda

🕑: 06:30 PM - 08:30 PM
Kama Floor Workshop
Info: Ready to take your skills to new heights? Our in-person Kama Floor workshop is the perfect place to learn, connect, and have a blast. Whether you're a newbie or a pro, this hands-on event will get you flying with confidence and style. Don’t miss out on an awesome experience filled with fun, tips, and plenty of action. See you there!

Participants should be physically healthy, relatively free from injury, and comfortable giving and receiving touch while sitting closely together on a floor mat. Visit us on Instagram to see Kama Flight in action @kamaflight

Also check out other Workshops in New York, Health & Wellness events in New York.
